card.name: First digit of a number
card.fires_on: A single digit (often 2, 3, 5 or 0) at the start or inside of a multi-digit number, right after a comparison like 'less than' or '<', or after '='. It is seen in lab thresholds, physics and engineering values.

modes.label: Threshold values
modes.description: Leading digit after 'less than' or '<' in lab or weight cutoffs.

modes.label: Digits in technical numbers
modes.description: A digit inside or starting a longer number in physics or math text.
